packageRules.description: Upper bounds on pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides are decisions (LAB-1020), not drift, so cross-major proposals wait under Pending Approval instead of opening a branch. Routine majors only — the vulnerability-alert path overrides this and gets through, which is why ci.yml's 'Verify bounded floor-pins stay in-major' step is the real gate. Rationale: CONTRIBUTING.md.
